character.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / stylized-concept.
Asset type: CHARACTER CONCEPT APPROVAL BOARD ONLY, never a gameplay screenshot or a sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is the identity reference/edit target: the current GuMaster2D character direction sheet. Restyle the EXISTING male jade-outfit, topknot, sword character in its top row; do not invent a replacement hero. Ignore its existing beige gallery layout and its female row when composing this board.
Primary request: a beautifully art-directed original wuxia cultivation game character approval board, with the expressive hand-inked storybook cutout quality of Don't Starve Together. This should be an actual drawing refinement, not a sepia filter over the reference. Hand-drawn variable-pressure black-brown contours, precise intentional imperfections, angular ink taper, selected crosshatching, warm aged-paper matte paint masses and slightly eccentric expression. Crisp authored strokes, not noisy fuzzy raster edges, not glossy vector cartoons.
Subject invariants: recognizable same young East Asian chibi cultivator; retain the broad head and roughly half-height head-to-body ratio, asymmetrical swept bangs and round tied topknot, familiar facial identity, jade green crossover robe with ivory collar/underlayer, dark cloth belt, muted leather boots, modest bronze/jade accents and straight short jian sword. Keep the original outfit motif and silhouette recognition. Maintain charm without oversized shiny anime irises; expressive inked eyes, ivory sclera and dark small pupils, restrained catchlights. Arms/hands have purposeful wrist grip, distinct thumb and fingers, plausible elbow bends; no extra limbs, floating joints, balloon mittens or plastic shine. Cloth folds are planar inked masses, not metallic piping. The sword is a wuxia straight jian, not a huge fantasy blade.
Composition: polished spacious landscape illustrated model-development sheet on clean light warm ivory paper with very subtle fiber texture and ample breathing room. One large full-body three-quarter idle hero is the dominant subject on the left. Across the upper right show three smaller consistent full-body turnaround drawings: front, true side profile, back. Across the bottom show four clear sequential action KEY POSES of exactly the same hero: walk contact, run passing, sword attack release, defensive guard. Pose drawings have anatomical bends and meaningful weight shift; foot positions are grounded. All figures fully visible with no overlap. No inset box/card frames. Fine caption typography, muted jade/ochre ink swatches and only a few natural line-detail flourishes.
Text verbatim: title "CỔ SƯ — CONCEPT 01"; section labels "CHÍNH DIỆN", "NGHIÊNG", "SAU LƯNG"; action labels "ĐI", "CHẠY", "TẤN CÔNG", "PHÒNG THỦ"; tiny footer "BẢN DUYỆT HÌNH".
Palette: ink #2b2521, dusty jade #657a61, parchment #e4dbc3, skin warm ivory/ochre, worn bronze #a58c61, charcoal olive hair. Dark shadow masses separated from midtones, paper-colored highlights with no gradients pretending to be 3D.
Avoid: copying Wilson or any Don't Starve character, Klei logos, survival hats, beard, western Victorian outfit, different haircut, replacing the character with a tall adult, pixel art, photorealism, anime glass eyes, 3D rendering, thick identical outlines, neon aura, excessive grunge, noisy stippling, ornate game HUD, UI code, fabricated gameplay evidence.
This image is a proposed art direction for HUMAN APPROVAL; the current game implementation stays unchanged.
character.input_role: Identity and existing character art to refine; not an asset from Don't Starve

ui.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: A high-fidelity illustrated PC GAMEPLAY UI CONCEPT for GuMaster2D, intended for human approval only.
Image 1 (current gameplay screenshot): layout and functional reference/edit target. Keep the same top-down PC game and its actual feature set; restyle its UI and illustrative presentation.
Image 2 (the newly proposed CHARACTER CONCEPT 01 drawing, still awaiting approval): character and ink/paint style reference. Use exactly that recognizable cultivator for the world hero and top-left portrait. Do not redesign the hero.
Style direction: original wuxia cultivation adaptation of Don't Starve Together's hand-inked paper-cutout storybook visual language. Warm parchment, variable-pressure dark ink, restrained crosshatching, worn bronze/jade small accents, hand-cut silhouettes. Beautiful deliberate typography and alignment; legible purposeful panel hierarchy, ample uncluttered playfield. Clean drawn edges, not pixelated, fuzzy, photorealistic or 3D.
One landscape 16:9 game screen, no external computer device frame, no moodboard grid. A calm hand-illustrated version of the existing stone village/olive forest backdrop supplies context, not a hero splash poster. Preserve the player-versus-wolf encounter and top-down scale/feet-on-ground viewpoint. Keep most of the central playfield clear. Draw the male jade-robed, black-brown topknot swordsman near center-left, at readable gameplay size, matching the CHARACTER CONCEPT.
UI composition based on the existing screenshot:
- Upper-left: compact portrait medallion in worn ink/bronze, clear two slender parchment-and-ink resource gauges. Exactly label "Sinh lực 200/200" and "Chân nguyên 100/100"; muted vermilion HP and muted slate/jade mana. Small "Cổ sư · Cấp 1" and "100 bạc". Do not add hunger or sanity meters.
- Below this: a small parchment quest slip with folded/torn edges, legible charcoal copy and three checkbox objectives. Header "KHẢO NGHIỆM"; objectives "Hạ sói rừng 0/3", "Thu phục Cổ 0/1", "Cho Cổ ăn 0/1". Subtle tracking/collapse affordance.
- Upper-center: quiet compact target strip "Sói rừng 140/140", with a narrow HP gauge and tiny target mark. It must not dominate the image.
- Upper-right: small compass/minimap showing the village, surrounded by a restrained imperfect ink ring and label "VẠN THÚ SƠN".
- Right side: open "HÀNH TRANG" paper panel of moderate width, so the playfield remains dominant. Exactly 30 clearly separated slots in a five-column, six-row grid, with simple hand-inked item silhouettes (Gu bugs, pelt, stone, feather, ice silk) and a few readable stack numerals. Filter labels "Tất cả", "Cổ", "Vật liệu". One jade-highlighted selected cell and a short selected-item detail "Nguyệt Quang"; no long body copy. Close affordance. Slot boundaries should be thin irregular ink rules, not 30 chunky glossy tiles.
- Bottom-center: compact practical four-skill dock. Precisely four large distinct hand-inked icons: crescent blade, protection shield, white feather, sharp frost crystal. Numerals "1", "2", "3", "4" at top-left of each icon. Labels "Nguyệt Quang", "Bạch Ngọc", "Bạch Hạc", "Băng Tằm". Thin XP line. Icons remain readable; parchment/ink frames with restrained jade selection. No invented extra skills.
- Bottom-right: unobtrusive small functional labels "Nhân vật F3", "Túi đồ F4", "Nhiệm vụ J". Small bottom hint "WASD · Shift chạy · 1–4 dùng Cổ".
- Tiny review watermark outside the active controls at the bottom edge: "CONCEPT UI — CHỜ DUYỆT".
The hierarchy should make the illustrated hero and playfield primary, health second, skills and inventory next, with quiet quest/map context. UI typography is dark readable print on light paper or warm ivory on charcoal ink; no UI design commentary rendered inside the controls.
Avoid: copied Don't Starve UI assets, Wilson, Klei logos, hunger/sanity controls, glossy bevels, plastic gradients, blue glowing sci-fi panels, elaborate gold MMO framing, heavy noisy grunge, dense unreadable text, overlapped labels, huge HUD occlusion, fake implementation status. This is an image proposal; it is not evidence of any game implementation.
